items.title: Coskeleton functors exist over a finitely complete category and are given by the limit formula
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Existence lemma (statement 2450-2464, proof 2466-2506): the coskeleton is constructed by the limit formula and its universal property is proven in both directions through an explicit unfolding of the limit and the displayed commutativity constraints; the assembly of the gamma(id_[k]) into a truncated morphism is the objectwise restatement of the definition (source line 2483). H2: formal category-theoretic construction.
